current_difficulty_reason: The singular force prevents a direct Lipschitz mean-field coupling even after the standard Ito, BDG and Wasserstein completeness prerequisites are supplied. The authors compare different particle counts by replication and prove a new index-weighted interaction-energy bound that controls the singular discrepancies and yields an explicit algebraic error rate. They then combine the complete uniform-time and path-supremum comparisons with independence of the empirical systems to obtain a deterministic continuous limit, rather than a random subsequential measure.
